title: Kissed, Light Japanese Chicken Gyoza
description: Delicate Japanese gyoza made with long-fermentation dough and rice paper sheets, filled with tender chicken and a touch of brininess.

ingredients.name: Long-fermentation dough
ingredients.notes: available at most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: Rice paper sheets
ingredients.notes: available at most Asian grocery stores

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine long-fermentation dough, scallions, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and fermented Korean chili flakes. Mix well to combine.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a thin circle.
Place a piece of dough on a flat surface and brush the edges with sesame oil.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of the chicken-shrimp mixture in the center of the dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal the gyoza.
Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat and add 1-2 tablespoons of sesame oil.
When the oil is hot, add the gyoza to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve the gyoza hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
